summary: On OpenShift, change the automation hub certificate by creating a TLS secret and setting spec.hub.route_tls_secret on the AnsibleAutomationPlatform custom resource; the operator applies it within a few minutes.
questions: How do I change the automation hub certificate on OpenShift?
Replace the hub route TLS certificate with the operator

answer_card.title: Hub route certificate on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc create secret tls hub-certs-$(date +%F) --cert=/path/to/ssl.crt --key=/path/to/ssl.key -n <namespace>
oc edit ansibleautomationplatform <aap-instance-name> -n <namespace>
```
```yaml
spec:
  hub:
    route_tls_secret: hub-certs-2024-03-24
```
Verify: `true | openssl s_client -showcerts -connect ${HUB_FQDN}:443`.
